status: First draft of the external -1 terrace from plan photo 46 and the user's 29 Oct 2026 description; review geometry, not installed
user_description: Starts at the outside metal stair that rises from the -2 garden and runs around the building at -1. Many interruptions are apertures that look down onto the exit ramp from the parking. On the C8 side the terrace widens to fill the gap between the office row (O13-O20) and the deeper rooms (Room 1, Room 2, L28).
frame: Campus metres of the -1 layout review: bounds are [east_min, north_min, east_max, north_max]

photo_fit.method: Original-pixel fit on photo 46. Photo x to campus north from the eight detected west-facade exit stars, whose campus points the layout already carries (seven detected; the eighth is under the blue annotation). Photo y to campus east from two traced faces: the office-row outer wall (O13-O20, east -17.5) at y 4048 and the Room 1/Room 2 facade at y 4207.
photo_fit.residual: Exit stars fit within 0.7 m; perspective is not corrected.

outer_edge.evidence: Thin outer line on photo 46, 40-47 px outside the facade: y 4254 north of core 3, 4251 under Room 2, 4247 along the recesses. Fitted east -25.58, -25.47 and -25.31; the mean is used.

south_run.evidence: The south facade of the West Offices block (north 2.0) carries a dotted line from the metal stair landing to the south-west corner. The strip is the stair's width (about 1.7 m), extended west, as the user describes it. Photo 46 places the south facade at about north 1.4 here; the 2.0 of the traced West Offices is kept.

west_run.evidence: Plan outer line starts about 2 m short of the north-west corner (north 105.4). No terrace line is drawn along the north facade, so the terrace stops here.

recesses.drawing_labels: Room 1 to L28, in front of O16-O20
recesses.evidence: Exits from Room 1 (north 38.31) and L28 (north 52.46) open sideways into this band; columns stand on the facade line.

recesses.drawing_labels: L28 to Room 2, in front of O13-O15
recesses.evidence: Exits from L28 (north 58.31) and Room 2 (north 72.46) open sideways into this band; columns stand on the facade line.

unresolved_recess_line.status: A thin line crosses this recess at photo y 4126. It may be a step, planter or soffit edge. Not built.

columns.evidence: Small squares on the facade line inside the two recesses (photo x 1560, 1729, 2053, 2215). The building line above continues over the terrace.

edge_segments.evidence: no outer line in front of stair core 3 and its two exit doors
no outer line just south of Room 2
outer line drawn along both recesses and L28
blue annotation around Room 1 covers the edge; no opening is guessed
no outer line along core 4 and the West Offices end rooms; the parking (-2) lies under this corner

south_edge_evidence: dotted line on the plan, from the stair landing to the south-west corner

edge_kinds.parapet: Solid upstand along a drawn plan line.
edge_kinds.aperture: Open metal railing where the plan draws no outer line. User: these openings look down onto the parking exit ramp. Interpreted as gaps in the parapet, not in the slab, so the terrace stays continuous from the stair. Unconfirmed.
edge_kinds.unresolved: Edge hidden on the plan; built as railing so nothing is invented and nobody falls.
edge_kinds.railing: Metal railing along the dotted south line.

metal_stair.top: west end, joining the terrace at the corner (east 31.8)
metal_stair.evidence: Hatched stair outside the south block on photo 46 (photo x 1155-1175 disp, y 925-1010 disp), with a mid landing. Photos 44 and 45 of 27 Oct show its perforated dark steel treads from the garden.
metal_stair.conflict: config/povo2_gardens.json puts Garden -2 at north 8.75-20 and its fixed UP stair at east 33.25-35.75, north 2.75-8.75. Plan 46 puts this metal stair at north 0.3-2.0, running east. The two registrations disagree by several metres. This terrace keeps the plan-46 position; the garden is not moved.

known_gaps_in_base: East of the West Offices (east 20.3-31.8) the -1 trace stops at north 6.92, because the rectified plan ends at source x = 100. Plan 46 shows the C5 end block reaching the same south facade at about north 1.5, so the south run is built along a facade the layout does not yet contain.
The north-west block (north 92.2-105.4, west of C8) has no traced rooms; the facade is assumed at east -23.74 there.
